reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that adds an ordered system-prompt section to make a DeepSeek Harness agent think and respond in simplified Chinese while preserving technical text.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加系统提示片段，使智能体默认使用简体中文思考和回答，并保留代码、命令及标识符原文。
summaries.en: Adds a system-prompt section for DeepSeek Harness that guides the agent to think and respond in simplified Chinese while preserving code, commands, and identifiers verbatim.

capabilities: Provides configurable instructions for simplified Chinese responses
Preserves code, commands, errors, identifiers, and URLs verbatim in responses
